summary: Morning brings a flat hand, palm up, up from under the other arm, like the sun rising over the horizon.
movement: Dominant hand rises from under the other arm
steps: Lay your non-dominant forearm flat in front of you, like a horizon.
Place your dominant hand, palm up, under it near the elbow.
Raise the dominant hand up past the arm, stopping at about a 45-degree angle.
mistakes: Raising it all the way vertical. That's NOON.
